title: Aureline M5 freeze-exception packet
description: Canonical per-domain packet for the extension-author and public preview cohorts. Names the documented freeze exception, the scope it widens, the readiness / rehearsal linkage that justifies it, its expiry, and whether the exception is documented rather than implicit so a freeze exception never becomes undocumented scope widening and public proof never outruns cohort evidence. Downstream shiproom, release-center, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a cohort's freeze-exception posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
